input_metric: result.usage.input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens; accumulated across API requests, not unique content
median: arithmetic mean of the two observations in each condition
quality_rule: same frozen ten-check rubric; no lower median B vs A; record serious unsupported claims separately
correction_rule: both C answers explicitly identify the false note, cite isZero, and distinguish negative balances
host_adapter: CLAUDE.md contains only @AGENTS.md in every subject checkout; baseline AGENTS.md contains a neutral read-only instruction only
